name: @fctl/site
description: https://fctl.sh: the landing page, fctl's docs, the legal pages, the installer and release downloads

scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/docs.mjs && node scripts/legal.mjs && node scripts/sitemap.mjs && node scripts/seo.mjs
scripts.check: biome check . && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p worker
scripts.test: node --test scripts/commits.test.mjs scripts/pages.test.mjs scripts/seo.test.mjs scripts/sitemap.test.mjs scripts/suggest.test.mjs scripts/worker.test.mjs
